<thought>To find a single‑step retrosynthetic transformation that corresponds to the reverse of a carbonyl‑ene reaction, I will search the template catalog for a template that (in the forward direction) breaks an alkene, forms an alcohol, and changes a carbonyl bond order (C=O → C‑O). This should match the reverse transformation needed for the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["alkene"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["alcohol"],
  "bonds_order_changed": ["C=O (2.0->1.0)"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
